product_overview: EduGuide AI is a web app that helps learners create AI-generated study roadmaps, practice with quizzes and flashcards, interact with a context-aware AI coach, and track progress across courses and modules.
core_goals: Create a personalized, AI-generated study roadmap from a short onboarding questionnaire
Practice and reinforce learning with AI-generated quizzes and flashcards for topics and modules
Use a context-aware AI chat coach to ask questions and get explanations related to study content
Track progress across courses and modules, manage multiple roadmaps, and keep per-module notes
Manage account, preferences (theme/language) and basic security (password reset, sign out)

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public marketing pages that introduce the product, surface features/pricing/FAQ, and direct visitors to sign up or view legal pages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through hero, features, pricing and FAQ sections -> Switch language between English and Vietnamese -> Activate Get Started CTA to navigate to /register -> Open privacy or terms links to navigate to /privacy and /terms

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account by providing name, email and a secure password; receive validation feedback and proceed to onboarding on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password (8+ chars with letter and number/symbol) -> Submit the registration form -> On success be redirected to /onboarding
Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in weak or too-short password -> Submit the registration form -> See validation errors for short or weak password or duplicate email

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in with email and password to access authenticated dashboard and learning tools, with a path to request password reset.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> On success be redirected to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in incorrect password -> Submit login form -> See error message for invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Trigger forgot password flow -> Navigate to /reset-password

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Request a password reset and set a new password using a token-based reset flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter email address to request reset -> Submit request form -> See confirmation that reset was requested
Open reset link with token in URL -> Enter and confirm new password -> Submit reset form -> On success be redirected to /login

features.name: Onboarding Wizard
features.description: Multi-step guided wizard that captures goals, level and preferences to generate a personalized AI study roadmap.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Choose a learning topic/subject -> Select current skill level -> Pick learning style and interests -> Set a goal and target deadline -> Submit the wizard to generate a roadmap -> Wait for generation to finish and be redirected to /dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Home
features.description: Authenticated home showing active course progress, key widgets, and quick access to learning tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View active course progress card and stats -> Resume last module to continue study -> Open sidebar navigation links to access other dashboard areas -> View widgets such as streak and daily goals -> Switch language or theme from header

features.name: Courses Management
features.description: List and manage generated roadmaps: set active roadmap, create new courses via onboarding, and remove unwanted roadmaps.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/courses -> View list of generated roadmaps and their progress percentages -> Select a course to set it as active and observe active status change -> Start a New Course creation flow to navigate to /onboarding -> Delete a roadmap and confirm deletion -> See the course list update

features.name: Study Plan & Modules
features.description: Browse detailed roadmap modules, expand modules to see sub-topics, and track completion per module.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/plan -> Browse modules in the roadmap -> Expand a module to view its sub-topics -> Mark a module complete -> See overall completion percentage update

features.name: Quiz / Test Practice
features.description: Generate AI-based multiple-choice quizzes for a selected topic, answer questions, and receive score and explanations.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/tests -> Select a module or topic for practice -> Request generation of a quiz for the topic -> Wait for the quiz to be generated -> Answer multiple-choice questions -> Submit answers -> See score and explanations

features.name: Flashcards
features.description: Generate and review AI-created flashcards for a topic with flip, navigate, and mastery-tracking actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open a module's flashcards section -> Request generation of flashcards for the topic -> Flip a card to reveal the answer -> Navigate to the next or previous card -> Mark a card as known or mark for review later

features.name: AI Chat Coach
features.description: Context-aware AI chat assistant available from the dashboard to ask questions and get guided explanations related to study material.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the chat panel -> Type a question and send the message -> See the AI response appear -> Clear the chat or start a new conversation
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the chat panel -> Rapidly send multiple messages until usage threshold is reached -> See a rate-limit message indicating the chat request limit

features.name: Notes
features.description: Per-module notes with create, edit and delete actions supporting markdown content and basic validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the notes panel -> Create a new note with title and markdown content -> Save the note and see it listed -> Edit an existing note and save changes -> Delete a note and confirm deletion -> See the note removed from the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the notes panel -> Create or edit a note with an excessively long title or content -> Attempt to save -> See validation errors for too-long title or content

features.name: Profile
features.description: View user learning profile details and quick stats about roadmaps, modules and streak.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/profile -> View name, email and current skill level -> View total roadmaps and modules -> View streak and completion statistics -> Navigate back to /dashboard

features.name: Settings
features.description: Manage account preferences including theme, language, request password reset, and sign out.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Toggle light or dark theme -> Switch language between English and Vietnamese -> Request password reset to send a reset email -> Sign out of the account -> After sign out navigate to /login

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Public status endpoint that returns basic service health information.
user_flows: Send GET request to /api/health -> Observe a response containing status and timestamp

known_limitations.issue: Password reset emails are not actually delivered; tokens are stored in DB and must be retrieved manually
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end password reset cannot be completed in tests without DB access to fetch the token

known_limitations.issue: AI generation endpoints are asynchronous via BullMQ and require a running worker process
known_limitations.impact: Without the worker running, /api/generate-roadmap, /api/generate-quiz, /api/generate-flashcards, /api/chat may stall or fail

known_limitations.issue: Free Plan rate limiting (15 req/min) on /api/chat
known_limitations.impact: High-frequency tests against chat will be throttled with 429

known_limitations.issue: Locale-prefixed routing is configured via next-intl but not all internal links use the locale prefix
known_limitations.impact: Some test scenarios that assert on /vi/... paths may need to use the non-prefixed URL
